entries.name: Mario Savio

expected.charges: Trespass, resisting arrest, unlawful assembly — December 2, 1964 Sproul Hall sit-in (FSM)
expected.sentence: 120 days actually served; released October 24, 1967, with the remaining 80 days of an aggregate 200-day jail sentence suspended.

updates.sentence: Sentenced on June 30, 1967 to 120 days for the Sproul Hall sit-in; released October 24, 1967. The remaining 80 days of the aggregate 200-day sentence were suspended. The recorded custody periods distinguish the initial December 1964 detention from the June–October 1967 term; the imposed 120 days is not substituted for elapsed custody.

entries.rationale: Seth Rosenfeld documents June 30 sentencing and October 24 release from FBI records; FBI Vault October 26 airtel confirms release October 24. Preserve already separated custody periods and calculated duration; clarify sentence versus elapsed custody.
